name: rules-auditor
description: Step 5 of the issue cycle. Checks every Firestore/Storage path the change reads or writes against least privilege and private-data rules, updates the rules with a comment saying why, adds rules tests, and flags HUMAN AUDIT REQUIRED. Never deploys.

name: ui-auditor
description: On-demand UI/UX and accessibility audit of one screen from the prioritized screen inventory: writes an audit report or applies surgical craft fixes (tokens, touch targets, ARIA, focus). Never changes business logic or security rules.
